story.title:
Our
Story
story.p1: Agendia was born in the heart of Santo Domingo, Dominican Republic, as a response to digital saturation. We observed how productivity tools were becoming more complex instead of more useful.
story.p2: In 2022, a small group of Dominican designers and developers decided to create a global standard of simplicity from the Caribbean, proving that world-class design has no borders.
story.p3: Today, Agendia is the tool chosen by creatives and architects around the world who value mental space as much as their physical time.

PrivacyPolicy.title: Privacy Policy
PrivacyPolicy.description: At Agendia.do, we value your privacy and are transparent about how we handle your data to offer you the best scheduling experience, in strict compliance with Dominican Republic regulations.

sidebar.questionsBody: Our legal team is here to help you with your doubts about privacy and compliance with Law 172-13.

intro.title: Introduction
intro.p1: This Privacy Policy describes how Agendia.do collects, uses, and protects the personal information you provide through our appointment management and scheduling platform.
intro.p2: By using our services, you accept the practices described in this document. We are committed to ensuring that your privacy is protected according to the highest technological security standards and in compliance with Law No. 172-13 on Protection of Personal Data of the Dominican Republic.

collection.title: Information We Collect
collection.p1: We collect information to provide better services to all our users. The information we collect includes:

list.account: Account Information: Name, email address, phone number (compliant with local regulations), and access credentials.
list.schedule: Scheduling Data: Appointment details, linked calendars, offered services, and time availability.
list.technical: Technical Information: IP address, browser type, operating system, and platform usage data via cookies.
list.payment: Payment Information: We process payments through secure external providers (like Azul, Cardnet, or Stripe); we do not store your full card details on our servers, complying with PCI-DSS standards.

usage.title: Use of Information
usage.p1: We use the collected information for the following purposes:

management.title: Appointment Management
management.desc: To facilitate scheduling, cancellation, and service reminders.

support.title: Technical Support
support.desc: To answer your queries and resolve technical issues.

improvement.title: Service Improvement
improvement.desc: We analyze usage patterns to optimize the interface and functionalities.

security.title: Security
security.desc: To protect against fraud and unauthorized access to accounts.

sharing.title: Data Sharing
sharing.p1: Agendia.do does not sell or rent your personal information to third parties. We share data only in the following situations:
sharing.p2: With Service Providers who help us with data hosting, payment processing, and analysis. These providers are contractually obligated to maintain confidentiality.
sharing.p3: For Legal Compliance, when required by law or in response to valid legal requests from public authorities, including the Dominican Institute of Telecommunications (INDOTEL) or competent courts.

rights.title: Your Rights (Law 172-13)
rights.p1: You have full control over your personal information. Under Dominican law, your rights include:

access.title: Access and Rectification (Habeas Data)
access.desc: You can review and update your information at any time from your settings panel or by requesting it directly.

forget.title: Right to be Forgotten / Cancellation
forget.desc: You can request the total deletion of your account and all associated data permanently when they are no longer necessary for the collected purposes.

portability.title: Portability and Opposition
portability.desc: Request a copy of your data or ask us to stop processing your information for specific purposes.
